definition: Secret and complicated schemes intended to achieve a usually harmful purpose.
author: Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra
quote: “I am Don Quixote of La Mancha, against whom your evil machinations avail not nor have any power.”
example_sentence: The plot is driven by the machinations of a jealous cousin.
